UserGameData.title: User Game Data
UserGameData.description: Stores the player's progress, credits, and building status.

credits.description: The amount of currency the player has.

defenseLevel.description: The player's current security defense level.

architecturalStage.description: The current stage of the player's building (-1 to 2).

lastUpdated.description: The last time the game state was saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of user-specific game progress data.
